waivers.name: arm
waivers.reason: the toy's tests never call it

waivers.name: getTask
waivers.reason: the toy's tests never call it

waivers.name: gate
waivers.reason: called only after its case's first busy input

waivers.name: open
waivers.reason: called only after its case's first busy input

waivers.name: submit
waivers.reason: every call lies inside a compared prefix, but the toy's submit settles only after the executor's answer, which arrives at or after the case's first busy input

waivers.name: waitForSignals
waivers.reason: called inside the compared prefix; it settles only past the case's first busy input

waivers.name: copy
waivers.reason: both its compared calls copy the same object, so they answer one value, with no port call between call and answer

waivers.name: fail
waivers.reason: its only call throws the toy's error: a refusal

waivers.name: ownWork
waivers.reason: its one compared answer comes with nothing between call and answer; its other call lies past a busy input

waivers.name: persistence.putShard
waivers.reason: the toy checks whether its persistence has it, and no toy test gives one

waivers.name: in step
waivers.reason: only the scripted driver writes input groups; the toy is recorded from its tests, never driven

waivers.name: group
waivers.reason: only the scripted driver places an input in a group; the toy is recorded from its tests, never driven
